title: 2013 AMC 10B Problem 2
statement: Mr. Green measures his rectangular garden by walking two of the sides and finds that it is \(15\) steps by \(20\) steps. Each of Mr. Green’s steps is \(2\) feet long. Mr. Green expects a half a pound of potatoes per square foot from his garden. How many pounds of potatoes does Mr. Green expect from his garden?

solutions.text:
The dimensions of the garden are \( 2\cdot 15 = 30\) feet by \(2\cdot 20=40\) feet. Thus, the square footage is \(30\cdot 40 = 1200.\)

Therefore, there are \[1200\cdot \dfrac 12 =600\] pounds of potatoes.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Convert each garden side from steps to feet
Multiply area by half a pound per square foot
